editorial:
Imagine you are at the top of your game, running for Congress and finally moving past a huge tragedy. Then, out of nowhere, the woman you loved and thought was dead for years just shows up in your life. That is exactly what happens to the main character here. The vibe is very mysterious and a bit tense, making you wonder if he is actually losing his mind or if something impossible is happening. You will feel his confusion as he tries to balance his high-pressure job with the shock of seeing a ghost from his past.

The acting is great and really sells the emotion of the story. The twists keep you guessing, though the middle part can feel a bit slow at times. If you love a good puzzle that mixes romance with a mystery, you will really enjoy this. Since it is an older flick, you might want to look for a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture. If you are not into discs, renting it on Apple TV is a quick and easy way to see if you like the story.
endingExplained: You find out that the woman was not a ghost or a hallucination. She actually survived the accident years ago but was kept away or hidden. The twist reveals that people in the main character's life lied to him to keep their own secrets safe. In the end, the truth comes out, the bad guys are exposed, and the couple finally gets a chance to be together after all the lies are cleared up.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a good mystery with a romantic heart.
